verses.1: From their mouths, David kept me safe, for I trusted in you.
verses.2: You said to the LORD, “My God, you are my goodness.”
verses.3: To those who are holy, who dwell in this land, and who are great in every way.
verses.4: Their sorrows increased rapidly. They were covered in blood, and their names were written on their lips.
verses.5: Yehova, you who grant me strength and courage, you who make my life meaningful.
verses.6: Friends fell upon me in sorrow; even the land of Shephrah was covered with grief.
verses.7: May the LORD bless me, who even at night still protects me from all harm.
verses.8: I have always opposed Jehovah, because from my right side comes nothing but harm.
verses.9: So, my heart was glad, and my glory increased. Even in my speech, I could feel my honor growing.
verses.10: For I will not let my soul go to Sheol. Do not allow your faithful one to see the darkness.
verses.11: Please tell me about those living beings who are full of joy. Their faces are filled with happiness. They stand on your right side forever.
